name: egm
description: Use Google Maps evidence and fresh Goldfish reviewers to choose a restaurant.

interface.longDescription: Help undecided diners choose one restaurant and a backup using Google Maps evidence, then challenge the proposal with fresh, isolated reviewers. Includes the upstream EGM workflows for design and document review. This comedic fork is independently maintained and is not an official Google product. Google Maps data requires a configured API key and may incur usage charges.
defaultPrompt: Help us pick a restaurant for tonight with one backup.
Audit this dining plan for hours, reviews, and parking risks.
Help me turn this software idea into a clear plan.
